thesis: Jake Paul and Jeff Wu announced the launch of a new $100 million growth fund focused on AI, defense, aerospace, infrastructure, and software, noting that the fund is already oversubscribed with investments in tier 1 names including Endoral, Cognition, Seronic, Modal, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, and others. The speakers discussed how Jake Paul transitioned from being a content creator and professional boxer to an investor, emphasizing that his entrepreneurial background, resilience, and ability to blend entertainment with business analysis make him a unique partner for building the future.
